markets.question: Pepsi Point of Sale Growth in October — Above 93
markets.rules:
If the Carbon Arc Pepsi Point of Sale Growth (October 2026) for October 2026 is above 93, then the market resolves to Yes. For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on finalized Carbon Arc values recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 2nd calendar day after the end of the month covered by this market. For example, finalized Carbon Arc values for August will be recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 2nd.

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Pepsi Point of Sale Growth was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's point-of-sale receipt panel using in-store and online purchases captured via receipt-scanning and rewards apps, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

markets.question: Israeli Parliamentary Election: 4th Place — Otzma Yehudit
markets.rules:
If Otzma Yehudit finishes in 4th place in the 2026 Israeli Knesset election according to the certified results, then the market resolves to Yes. Ranking is determined by the specified counting method:
For proportional representation: rank follows the electoral authority's final seat allocation order.

Rank is based on Knesset seats, not national vote share, using the Central Elections Committee's final certified result rather than preliminary counts.
A party or list awarded no seats cannot place 4th.
Lists with equal seat totals share the places they jointly occupy. For example, if two lists tie for the 3rd-most seats, both are tied for 3rd and 4th place; if two lists tie for the most seats, the list with the next-most seats finishes 3rd.
Joint candidate lists count as single entities. Their seats are not credited separately to constituent parties. A newly formed joint list is a separate entity; a name change alone does not change a party or list's identity. Seats of separate lists are not combined for surplus-vote agreements or post-election coalitions.
If no listed party or list finishes or ties for 4th place, every market on this event resolves NO.

markets.question: Gold price on Oct 16, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT? — Above $4147.99
markets.rules: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for gold on October 16, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT is above 4147.99 USD/t.oz, then the market resolves to Yes. The settlement value is rounded to the nearest 2 decimal places. When confirming the settlement value, note the close price for the 1-minute candlestick at a given time is the price at the end of the immediately preceding one-minute interval. For example, the candlestick timestamped 4:59 PM reflects trading during 4:59:00 PM to 4:59:59 PM and closes at 5:00:00 PM. If no data is published by the specified source agency for the specified time, then the most recently available published data will be used to resolve the market.
